name: Introduction to Networking
description: Covers fundamental networking concepts including OSI model, TCP/IP protocols, network topologies, IP addressing, subnetting, routing and basic network configuration and troubleshooting.

name: Systems Software and Computing Concepts
description: Introduces operating systems concepts including process management, memory management, file systems, concurrency and computer architecture. Covers CPU organisation and system-level programming.

name: Introduction to Databases
description: Covers relational database design, entity-relationship modelling, normalisation and SQL querying. Students design and implement relational databases using a database management system.

name: Digital Thinking and Innovation
description: Introduces design thinking, creative problem solving and innovation frameworks. Students develop critical thinking, ideation and prototyping skills for technology-driven solutions.

name: Python Programming
description: Introduces programming using Python including variables, control structures, functions, lists, dictionaries, file handling and basic object-oriented programming. Emphasis on algorithmic thinking and problem solving.

name: Systems Analysis and Design
description: Covers the software development lifecycle, requirements gathering, use case modelling, data flow diagrams and UML system design. Students analyse business requirements and produce system specifications.

name: Integrated Computer Systems
description: Explores hardware and software integration including computer architecture, assembly language basics, input/output systems and embedded computing concepts.

name: Fundamental of Entrepreneurship
description: Introduces entrepreneurial thinking, business model development, startup ecosystems and innovation management. Students develop communication, teamwork and business planning skills.

name: Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming
description: Covers object-oriented programming principles including classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation and abstraction. Students implement OOP solutions using Java.

name: Mathematical Concepts for Computing
description: Covers discrete mathematics, logic, sets, functions, graph theory, probability and combinatorics applied to computing. Builds mathematical foundations for algorithm analysis.

name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Introduces AI concepts including search algorithms, knowledge representation, machine learning basics and intelligent agents. Students explore AI techniques applied to real-world problems.

name: Fundamentals of Web Design and Development
description: Covers HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals for building responsive web pages. Students learn web design principles, accessibility and basic front-end development techniques.

name: Innovation Process
description: Examines structured approaches to innovation including lean startup, Agile methodologies and design sprints. Students apply innovation frameworks to develop and validate technology product ideas.

name: Research Methods for Computing and Technology
description: Covers quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, literature review techniques, research design, data collection and academic writing for computing research.

name: Programming for Data Analysis
description: Introduces data analysis using Python libraries including NumPy, Pandas and Matplotlib. Topics include data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, statistical analysis and data visualisation.

name: System Development Methods
description: Covers software development methodologies including Agile, Scrum, Waterfall and DevOps. Students learn sprint planning, backlog management, continuous integration and software project management.

name: Object Oriented Development with Java
description: Advanced Java programming covering design patterns, collections framework, exception handling, multithreading, file I/O and building enterprise-grade object-oriented applications using Java.

name: Requirements Engineering
description: Covers techniques for eliciting, analysing, specifying and validating software requirements including functional and non-functional requirements, use cases, user stories and requirements traceability.

name: Enterprise Systems
description: Examines enterprise application architecture, ERP systems, middleware and integration patterns using Jakarta EE. Students design and evaluate large-scale enterprise software solutions.

name: Data Structures
description: Covers fundamental data structures including arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs and hash tables. Emphasis on algorithm complexity analysis, sorting and searching techniques.

name: Software Testing
description: Covers software testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, system testing and acceptance testing. Topics include test-driven development, automated testing and quality assurance.

name: Software Architecture
description: Introduces architectural styles and patterns including MVC, microservices, layered architecture and event-driven systems. Students design scalable and maintainable software architectures.

name: Design Methods
description: Covers UML modelling, design patterns including Singleton, Factory and Observer, and software design principles including SOLID. Students apply design techniques to produce robust software designs.

name: Concurrent Programming
description: Covers multithreading, synchronisation, parallel computing, deadlock prevention and concurrent data structures. Students implement concurrent programs and analyse race conditions and thread safety.

name: Further Web Design and Development
description: Advanced web development covering React, REST API design, authentication, state management and full-stack application development using JavaScript and CSS frameworks.

name: Mobile App Engineering
description: Covers mobile application development for Android and iOS platforms. Topics include UI design, lifecycle management, data persistence, REST APIs and publishing mobile applications using Kotlin or Swift.

name: Venture Building
description: Focuses on building technology ventures including business model canvas, market validation, pitch development and startup financing. Students develop entrepreneurial and leadership skills.

name: Development and Operations
description: Covers DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerisation with Docker, infrastructure as code using Terraform, monitoring and cloud deployment on AWS or Azure.

name: Investigations in Software Engineering
description: A research-based module where students investigate current topics and challenges in software engineering through literature review, experimentation and critical analysis.

name: Project Management
description: Covers software project planning, estimation, scheduling, risk management and team leadership. Students apply Agile and Scrum project management tools including Gantt charts and earned value analysis.

name: Design Patterns
description: Advanced coverage of Gang of Four design patterns, architectural patterns and anti-patterns using Java. Students apply creational, structural and behavioural patterns to solve complex software design problems.

name: Software Quality Engineering
description: Covers software quality metrics, static analysis, code reviews, test automation frameworks, performance testing and continuous quality improvement in software development.

name: User Experience
description: Covers UX research methods, usability testing, wireframing, prototyping and interaction design. Students apply human-centred design principles to evaluate and improve software interfaces.

name: Project in Software Engineering
description: Final year project requiring students to design, develop and evaluate a software engineering solution for a real-world problem demonstrating technical, analytical and project management skills.

name: Designing and Developing Applications on Cloud
description: Covers cloud application development using AWS or Azure. Topics include serverless computing, cloud-native architecture, microservices deployment, Docker containers and cloud security.

name: Distributed Computer Systems
description: Covers distributed system concepts including consistency, fault tolerance, CAP theorem, distributed databases, message queues and designing distributed applications.

name: Enterprise Programming for Distributed Applications
description: Covers enterprise Java frameworks including Jakarta EE, RESTful web services, microservices and distributed application design patterns for large-scale systems.

name: Blockchain Development
description: Introduces blockchain technology, smart contracts, decentralised applications and consensus mechanisms. Students build and deploy blockchain-based solutions.

name: Advanced Database Systems
description: Covers advanced database topics including query optimisation, transaction management, distributed databases, NoSQL systems including MongoDB and big data storage solutions.

name: Optimisation and Deep Learning
description: Covers mathematical optimisation techniques and deep learning architectures including neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs and RNNs. Students implement and train deep learning models using Python.
